about: Public namespaces and enumerated vocabularies declared for served provenance strings (a declaration: nothing in this release scans served values against it). Every id here is one the served page itself defines (tests/public-fields.test.mjs proves each id is served); a pointer field resolves only into the namespace or vocabulary inventory.json names for it, and a prose token that is one of these ids is public. notation: whole-segment patterns for public technical notation (parallelism degrees, number formats). compoundWords: the ordinary words and units that may join a number, a declared name or notation in a hyphenated compound (72-GPU, H100-class, round-4); a compound that carries a digit and a word outside this list is not a public form (a row or record label is not one).

describe.caseIds: width and topology case ids the engine registers (engine-data-v22.js WORKER_CANDIDATE_SOURCES and every *_TOPOLOGY_SENSITIVITY case); sourceCaseId resolves here
describe.calibrationRefs: references into the engine's calibration registries (CALIBRATION.<hardware>, HW.<hardware>, PREFILL_CAL); calibrationRef resolves here
describe.blendRefs: a DC coverage row's blend: state:blend (the state's own blend, the engine's default branch) or fleet:<id> of a registered fleet; blendRef resolves here
describe.dcRefs: shared DC registry-row references; no served row carries a literal dcRef today, so the list is empty and any literal fails
describe.registryRefs: an engine registry entry cited in prose (PRICE_EVIDENCE.<hardware>)
describe.perspectiveIds: exploration perspective ids the page offers and permalinks carry (engine.js PERSPECTIVES)
describe.evidenceKeys: anchor ids of the served evidence fixture (tests/evidence-instances-v22.json anchors[].id)
describe.evidenceFamilies: a family prefix shared by two or more served anchor ids, used to cite the family (gb300-mlperf-v6-offline, trn2-neuron-llama70b, …)
describe.calibrationObservations: fitted operating points the engine names after a fit label ("F1 h800-prod-dec")
describe.dcIds: DC registry row ids (REGIONS, DATACENTERS, PROGRAMMES)
describe.evidenceTasks: open evidence tasks the published changelog names
describe.methodLabels: labels of the page's own method shown in its served text: the frozen derivation's joint-decode fits (F1-F6, F6-informed), the anchor score-set eligibility label (E1-ineligible), and the Trainium platform-constant carry (trn2-carry)
